verdict.rationale: LightSprint has no documented tiered autonomy levels for agents. It offers adjacent oversight controls: merges are gated by GitHub branch rules, required reviews and merge authority (docs-17, docs-22), and admins can control which external services agents reach from their sandboxes (docs-28). These give a fixed human-approval gate at merge rather than configurable per-action autonomy tiers. Missing for 10: configurable autonomy levels or tiers, per-action rules for what agents may do without confirmation, documentation of how such settings are configured, and independent corroboration.
